name: Trivia
description: Test your NFL and league knowledge

commands.name: trivia
commands.longDescription: Start a trivia question in the channel with NFL general knowledge questions.

examples.output:
🏈 NFL Trivia!
Q: Which team won Super Bowl LVIII?
[Chiefs] [49ers] [Eagles] [Ravens]

tips: 15% chance to catch an NFLmon on correct answers
Training NFLmon earn 5-15 XP per correct answer

commands.name: trivialeaderboard
commands.longDescription: See the top 10 trivia players ranked by correct answers.

examples.output:
🧠 Trivia Leaderboard
1. AJ Boorde - 47 correct
2. Nixon Ball - 42 correct
...

commands.name: triviastats
commands.description: View trivia stats for a user
commands.longDescription: View detailed trivia statistics for yourself or another user, including total answers, accuracy, and category breakdown.

options.name: user
options.description: The user to view stats for

examples.output:
📊 Your Trivia Stats
Correct: 47 | Incorrect: 12 | Accuracy: 79.7%
NFL: 32 | WPFL: 15
